title: x1: Learning to Think Adaptively Across Languages and Cultures

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating models on the FORK and CulturalBench datasets to probe cultural biases in commonsense reasoning (e.g., food-related customs) and assess cultural knowledge recall accuracy across different reasoning languages.

Measuring cross-lingual performance disparities on multilingual mathematical benchmarks (MGSM, MT-AIME) to evaluate the impact of forcing models to reason in a dominant language (English) versus natively advantageous languages.
